# camunda_ip_ranges (Data Source)

IP ranges Camunda SaaS services connect from. Use them to allow those services through a firewall or IP allowlist.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "camunda_ip_ranges" "all" {}

output "web_modeler_ip_ranges" {
  value = data.camunda_ip_ranges.all.web_modeler
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `ip-ranges`.
- `web_modeler` (List of String) IP ranges Web Modeler connects from, for example when calling a connector's endpoint.
